<script>
(function(){
'use strict';
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- data */
function J(id){ return JSON.parse(document.getElementById(id).textContent); }
var D = {
  fScreen: J('data-forest-screen'), fHeld: J('data-forest-heldout'), fMesh: J('data-forest-mesh'), fIvw: J('data-forest-ivw'),
  evS: J('data-events-screen'), evH: J('data-events-heldout'), evM: J('data-events-mesh'),
  concepts: J('data-concepts'), subs: J('data-subfields'), exPool: J('data-example-pool'), exEvent: J('data-example-event'),
  cases: J('data-cases'), margins: J('data-margins'), mIvw: J('data-margins-ivw'), fields: J('data-fields'),
  adopt: J('data-adopters'), closure: J('data-closure')
};
var FOLDNAME = {screen:'Screen', heldout:'Held-out', mesh:'MeSH', ivw:'Pooled (IVW)'};

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- terms */
var TERMS = {
  entry: ['Host-entry event', 'The first year in which a concept appears in a non-origin subfield together with at least five co-occurring partner terms.'],
  share: ['Host-vocabulary share', 'The tag-weighted mean of each partner’s pre-entry publication share in the host subfield, where each co-occurrence edge is weighted by its association strength.'],
  newcomer: ['Newcomer uptake', 'The count of host-subfield papers by author-disjoint newcomers (authors with no prior concept paper and no co-authorship with concept authors) during the five years after entry.'],
  ct: ['Co-transfer', 'The fraction of entry partners that were origin companions of the concept in the five years before entry.'],
  irr: ['IRR per SD', 'Incidence-rate ratio per one standard deviation of host-vocabulary share: 1.23 means 23% more newcomer papers for an entry one SD higher in share.'],
  ppml: ['PPML', 'Poisson pseudo-maximum-likelihood regression, here with concept-clustered standard errors.'],
  coprimary: ['Co-primary specification', 'PPML with concept, entry-year and host fixed effects, declared for use when the primary specification drops below 30 concept clusters.'],
  primary: ['Primary specification', 'PPML with concept-by-entry-year and host-by-entry-year fixed effects; it absorbs more confounding but keeps fewer events.'],
  folds: ['Screen and Held-out folds', 'The 366 main emerging concepts split by a SHA-1 hash on concept identifiers (247 Screen, 119 Held-out). Both folds were used in pipeline development, so their estimates are development-set estimates.'],
  mesh: ['MeSH check population', 'An independent biomedical arm of 191 concepts drawn from new MeSH descriptors, surviving a provenance filter, a PubMed novelty pre-screen and the same early-volume rule.'],
  ivw: ['IVW', 'Inverse-variance weighting, used to pool estimates across the Screen, Held-out and MeSH folds.'],
  extensive: ['Extensive margin', 'Whether any newcomer uptake starts, estimated with a linear probability model.'],
  intensive: ['Intensive margin', 'The count of newcomer papers given that uptake started, estimated with PPML conditional on uptake.'],
  rooted: ['Rooted entry', 'An entry reaching binary establishment: at least five newcomer papers in at least three of the five years after entry.'],
  persist: ['Persistent-neighbour closure', 'The closure coefficient restricted to the top-20 neighbours present in both year y and y−1.'],
  constraint: ['Burt constraint', 'A measure of redundancy in the weighted ego network. In Burt’s framework, brokerage means low constraint.'],
  sustained: ['Sustained uptake', 'A concept-year reaching at least 20 papers per year and gaining at least 20 percentile points in co-word network strength relative to the focal population.'],
  holm: ['Holm correction', 'A step-down adjustment of p-values that controls for testing several closure measures at once.'],
  outcomeblind: ['Outcome-blind', 'The inclusion criteria and frame were frozen and SHA-256-hashed before any post-appearance data were inspected.'],
  vocabclass: ['FOREIGN, ADJACENT, NATIVE', 'Partner vocabulary classes by host share: FOREIGN below 5% (origin vocabulary), ADJACENT 5% to 30%, NATIVE above 30% (host vocabulary).']
};
var termSeq = 0, openTerm = null;
function closeTerm(){ if(openTerm){ openTerm.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false'); openTerm._def.classList.remove('on'); openTerm = null; } }
function openT(btn){
  if(openTerm && openTerm !== btn) closeTerm();
  btn._def.classList.add('on'); btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true'); openTerm = btn;
  var d = btn._def; d.style.left='0px';
  var r = d.getBoundingClientRect(), vw = document.documentElement.clientWidth;
  if(r.right > vw - 8){ d.style.left = (vw - 8 - r.right) + 'px'; }
  r = d.getBoundingClientRect(); if(r.left < 8){ d.style.left = (parseFloat(d.style.left)||0) + (8 - r.left) + 'px'; }
}
function wireTerm(btn){
  var key = btn.getAttribute('data-term'); var t = TERMS[key]; if(!t) return;
  var id = 'def-' + key + '-' + (termSeq++);
  var d = document.createElement('span'); d.className='def'; d.id=id; d.setAttribute('role','tooltip'); d.textContent = t[1];
  btn.appendChild(d); btn._def = d;
  btn.setAttribute('aria-describedby', id); btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
  btn.addEventListener('mouseenter', function(){ openT(btn); });
  btn.addEventListener('focus', function(){ openT(btn); });
  btn.addEventListener('click', function(ev){ ev.stopPropagation(); openT(btn); });
  btn.addEventListener('mouseleave', function(){ if(document.activeElement !== btn) closeTerm(); });
  btn.addEventListener('blur', function(){ if(openTerm === btn && !btn.matches(':hover')) closeTerm(); });
}
document.addEventListener('click', function(ev){ if(openTerm && !openTerm.contains(ev.target)) closeTerm(); });
document.addEventListener('keydown', function(ev){ if(ev.key === 'Escape'){ closeTerm(); hideTip(); } });

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- format */
function f2(x){ return (Math.round(x*100)/100).toFixed(2); }
function fx(x, d){ return x.toFixed(d); }
function sgn(x, d){ var s = x.toFixed(d); return (x > 0 ? '+' : '') + s; }
function fP(p){ if(p === null || p === undefined) return 'n/a'; if(p < 0.001) return '<0.001'; if(p < 0.1) return p.toFixed(3); return p.toFixed(2); }
function pct(x, d){ return (x*100).toFixed(d === undefined ? 0 : d) + '%'; }
function nfmt(n){ return n.toLocaleString('en-US'); }
function esc(s){ return String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g, function(c){ return {'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;'}[c]; }); }

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- svg helpers */
var NS = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
function el(tag, attrs, parent){ var e = document.createElementNS(NS, tag); if(attrs) for(var k in attrs) e.setAttribute(k, attrs[k]); if(parent) parent.appendChild(e); return e; }
function tx(parent, x, y, s, attrs){ var t = el('text', Object.assign({x:x, y:y}, attrs||{}), parent); t.textContent = s; return t; }
function measure(svg, strs, cls){ var g = el('g', {}, svg), w = 0; strs.forEach(function(s){ var t = tx(g, 0, 0, s, {'class':cls}); w = Math.max(w, t.getComputedTextLength()); }); g.remove(); return w; }
function newSvg(host, h, label){ host.innerHTML=''; var W = Math.max(280, Math.floor(host.clientWidth)); var s = el('svg', {width:W, height:h, viewBox:'0 0 '+W+' '+h, role:'img', 'aria-label':label}, host); return s; }
function niceTicks(lo, hi, n){ var span = hi - lo, step = Math.pow(10, Math.floor(Math.log10(span/n))), err = n/span*step;
  if(err <= .15) step*=10; else if(err <= .35) step*=5; else if(err <= .75) step*=2;
  var out=[]; for(var v=Math.ceil(lo/step)*step; v<=hi+1e-9; v+=step) out.push(+v.toFixed(10)); return out; }
function drawXAxis(svg, sc, ticks, y0, y1, x0, x1, title, fmt, nullAt){
  var placed = [], g = el('g', {}, svg);
  ticks.forEach(function(t){ var x = sc(t); if(x < x0-0.5 || x > x1+0.5) return;
    el('line', {x1:x, x2:x, y1:y0, y2:y1, 'class':'gridl'}, g); });
  ticks.forEach(function(t){ var x = sc(t); if(x < x0-0.5 || x > x1+0.5) return;
    var lab = tx(g, x, y1 + 16, fmt(t), {'class':'tick','text-anchor':'middle'});
    var w = lab.getComputedTextLength(), l = x - w/2, r = x + w/2;
    if(placed.some(function(p){ return !(r + 6 < p[0] || l - 6 > p[1]); })){ lab.remove(); return; }
    placed.push([l, r]); });
  if(nullAt !== undefined && nullAt !== null){ var nx = sc(nullAt); el('line', {x1:nx, x2:nx, y1:y0, y2:y1, 'class':'nulll'}, g); }
  el('line', {x1:x0, x2:x1, y1:y1, y2:y1, stroke:'#9aa1a9'}, g);
  tx(g, (x0 + x1)/2, y1 + 38, title, {'class':'axt','text-anchor':'middle'});
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- chart tooltip */
var tip = document.getElementById('tip'), tipOwner = null;
function showTip(target, html){ tip.innerHTML = html; tip.classList.add('on'); tipOwner = target;
  var r = target.getBoundingClientRect(), tw = tip.offsetWidth, th = tip.offsetHeight, vw = document.documentElement.clientWidth;
  var x = Math.min(Math.max(8, r.left + r.width/2 - tw/2), vw - tw - 8), y = r.top - th - 10; if(y < 8) y = r.bottom + 10;
  tip.style.left = x + 'px'; tip.style.top = y + 'px'; }
function hideTip(){ tip.classList.remove('on'); tipOwner = null; }
window.addEventListener('scroll', function(){ if(tipOwner) hideTip(); }, {passive:true});
document.addEventListener('click', function(ev){ if(tipOwner && !tipOwner.contains(ev.target)) hideTip(); });
function markify(g, label, html){
  g.setAttribute('class', 'mark'); g.setAttribute('tabindex', '0'); g.setAttribute('role', 'img'); g.setAttribute('aria-label', label);
  var show = function(){ showTip(g, html); };
  g.addEventListener('mouseenter', show); g.addEventListener('focus', show);
  g.addEventListener('click', function(ev){ ev.stopPropagation(); show(); });
  g.addEventListener('mouseleave', hideTip); g.addEventListener('blur', hideTip);
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- forest chart */
/* rows: {type:'group', label} or {label, est, lo, hi, color, shape, val, tip, aria} */
function forest(host, rows, o){
  var W = Math.max(280, Math.floor(host.clientWidth)), narrow = W < 600;
  var rowH = narrow ? 50 : 32, grpH = 30, top = 8;
  var H = top; rows.forEach(function(r){ H += r.type === 'group' ? grpH : rowH; }); var axisTop = H; H += 52;
  var svg = newSvg(host, H, o.aria);
  var labs = rows.filter(function(r){ return r.type !== 'group'; });
  var labW = narrow ? 0 : Math.ceil(measure(svg, labs.map(function(r){ return r.label; }), 'lab')) + 14;
  var valW = narrow ? 0 : Math.ceil(measure(svg, labs.map(function(r){ return r.val; }), 'val')) + 16;
  var x0 = labW + 10, x1 = W - valW - 14;
  var lo = o.min, hi = o.max;
  labs.forEach(function(r){ lo = Math.min(lo, r.lo); hi = Math.max(hi, r.hi); });
  var sc;
  if(o.log){ lo = lo / 1.06; hi = hi * 1.06; var L0 = Math.log(lo), L1 = Math.log(hi); sc = function(v){ return x0 + (Math.log(v) - L0) / (L1 - L0) * (x1 - x0); }; }
  else { var pad = (hi - lo) * 0.06; lo -= pad; hi += pad; sc = function(v){ return x0 + (v - lo) / (hi - lo) * (x1 - x0); }; }
  var ticks = o.log ? [0.25,0.3,0.4,0.5,0.6,0.7,0.8,0.9,1,1.1,1.25,1.5,1.75,2,2.5,3,4,5,6,8].filter(function(t){ return t >= lo && t <= hi; }) : niceTicks(lo, hi, narrow ? 4 : 7);
  drawXAxis(svg, sc, ticks, top, axisTop, x0, x1, o.xlabel, o.tickFmt || function(t){ return String(t); }, o.nullAt);
  var y = top;
  rows.forEach(function(r){
    if(r.type === 'group'){ tx(svg, narrow ? 0 : 0, y + 20, r.label, {'class':'grp'}); y += grpH; return; }
    var cy = narrow ? y + 34 : y + rowH/2;
    if(narrow){ tx(svg, 0, y + 15, r.label + '  ' + r.val, {'class':'lab', style:'font-size:13px'}); }
    else { tx(svg, 0, cy + 5, r.label, {'class':'lab'}); tx(svg, W - valW + 4, cy + 5, r.val, {'class':'val'}); }
    var g = el('g', {}, svg);
    el('rect', {x:Math.min(sc(r.lo), sc(r.est)) - 8, y:cy - 12, width:Math.max(sc(r.hi) - sc(r.lo), 0) + 16, height:24, rx:4, 'class':'hit'}, g);
    el('line', {x1:sc(r.lo), x2:sc(r.hi), y1:cy, y2:cy, stroke:r.color, 'stroke-width':2.4}, g);
    var cx = sc(r.est);
    if(r.shape === 'diamond') el('path', {d:'M'+cx+' '+(cy-8)+'L'+(cx+8)+' '+cy+'L'+cx+' '+(cy+8)+'L'+(cx-8)+' '+cy+'Z', fill:r.color}, g);
    else if(r.shape === 'open') el('circle', {cx:cx, cy:cy, r:6, fill:'#fff', stroke:r.color, 'stroke-width':2.4}, g);
    else el('circle', {cx:cx, cy:cy, r:6.5, fill:r.color}, g);
    markify(g, r.aria || (r.label + ' ' + r.val), r.tip);
    y += rowH;
  });
  return svg;
}

/* ================================================================ 1. FINDING */
var allForest = [].concat(D.fScreen, D.fHeld, D.fMesh);
(function(){
  var mesh = D.fMesh.filter(function(r){ return r.spec === 'coprimary' && r.var === 'A_cont'; })[0];
  document.getElementById('big-number').textContent = '+' + Math.round((mesh.est - 1) * 100) + '%';
  document.getElementById('big-cap').innerHTML = 'more newcomer papers per one-standard-deviation increase in host-vocabulary share, on the independent <button type="button" class="term" data-term="mesh">MeSH</button> biomedical population (IRR ' + f2(mesh.est) + ', 95% CI ' + f2(mesh.lo) + ' to ' + f2(mesh.hi) + '; pre-registered verdict: REPLICATED).';
})();
function drawForest(){
  var spec = document.querySelector('input[name=spec]:checked').value;
  var showCT = document.getElementById('f-ct').checked;
  var folds = Array.prototype.filter.call(document.querySelectorAll('.f-fold'), function(c){ return c.checked; }).map(function(c){ return c.value; });
  var rows = [], shown = [];
  ['screen','heldout','mesh'].forEach(function(f){
    if(folds.indexOf(f) < 0) return;
    var rs = allForest.filter(function(r){ return r.fold === f && r.spec === spec; });
    rows.push({type:'group', label: FOLDNAME[f] + (f === 'mesh' ? ' (independent replication)' : ' (development set)')});
    rs.forEach(function(r){
      if(r.var === 'CT' && !showCT) return;
      var isA = r.var === 'A_cont', col = isA ? (f === 'mesh' ? 'var(--mesh)' : 'var(--accent)') : 'var(--base)';
      var name = isA ? 'Host-vocabulary share' : 'Co-transfer';
      var val = f2(r.est) + ' [' + f2(r.lo) + ', ' + f2(r.hi) + ']';
      rows.push({label:name, est:r.est, lo:r.lo, hi:r.hi, color:col, shape: spec === 'primary' ? 'open' : 'circle', val:val,
        aria: FOLDNAME[f] + ', ' + name + ', IRR per SD ' + val + ', p ' + fP(r.p),
        tip: '<b>' + FOLDNAME[f] + ' · ' + name + '</b><br>' + (spec === 'primary' ? 'Primary (concept×year + host×year FE)' : 'Co-primary (concept + year + host FE)') + '<br>IRR/SD ' + val + '<br>p = ' + fP(r.p) + (r.p_wild !== null && r.p_wild !== undefined && isA ? ' (wild-cluster p = ' + fP(r.p_wild) + ')' : '') + '<br>N = ' + nfmt(r.N) + ' events, G = ' + r.G + ' concept clusters'});
      if(isA) shown.push(r);
    });
  });
  if(folds.indexOf('ivw') >= 0){
    rows.push({type:'group', label:'Pooled across three folds'});
    if(spec === 'coprimary'){
      var v = D.fIvw, val = f2(v.est) + ' [' + f2(v.lo) + ', ' + f2(v.hi) + ']';
      rows.push({label:'Host-vocabulary share', est:v.est, lo:v.lo, hi:v.hi, color:'var(--pool)', shape:'diamond', val:val,
        aria:'Inverse-variance weighted pooled estimate ' + val, tip:'<b>IVW pooled co-primary</b><br>IRR/SD ' + val + '<br>I² = ' + v.I2 + ' (no heterogeneity)'});
    }
  }
  var host = document.getElementById('c-forest');
  if(rows.filter(function(r){ return r.type !== 'group'; }).length === 0){ host.innerHTML = '<p class="small">Select at least one fold.</p>'; }
  else forest(host, rows, {log:true, min:0.9, max:1.1, nullAt:1, xlabel:'IRR per SD of host-vocabulary share (log scale)', aria:'Forest plot of incidence-rate ratios by fold'});
  // takeaway
  var t;
  var ex = shown.filter(function(r){ return r.lo > 1; });
  if(spec === 'coprimary'){
    t = shown.length ? (ex.length + ' of ' + shown.length + ' shown folds have a host-share interval entirely above 1 (' + shown.map(function(r){ return FOLDNAME[r.fold] + ' ' + f2(r.est); }).join(', ') + ').') : 'Only the pooled estimate is shown.';
    if(folds.indexOf('ivw') >= 0) t += ' Pooled, the effect is ' + f2(D.fIvw.est) + ' [' + f2(D.fIvw.lo) + ', ' + f2(D.fIvw.hi) + '].';
    if(showCT) t += ' Every co-transfer interval shown includes 1.';
  } else {
    var ho = shown.filter(function(r){ return r.fold === 'heldout'; })[0], ms = shown.filter(function(r){ return r.fold === 'mesh'; })[0];
    t = 'The strict specification keeps fewer events.';
    if(ho) t += ' On Held-out it is inconclusive: ' + f2(ho.est) + ' [' + f2(ho.lo) + ', ' + f2(ho.hi) + '] with ' + ho.G + ' clusters, declared underpowered in advance.';
    if(ms) t += ' On MeSH it stays significant at ' + f2(ms.est) + ' [' + f2(ms.lo) + ', ' + f2(ms.hi) + '].';
    t += ' No pooled estimate was computed for this specification.';
  }
  document.getElementById('t-forest').textContent = t;
}
document.querySelectorAll('input[name=spec], #f-ct, .f-fold').forEach(function(c){ c.addEventListener('change', drawForest); });

/* ================================================================ events */
var CN = {}; D.concepts.forEach(function(c, i){ CN[i] = c[1]; });
function sub(id){ return D.subs[String(id)] || ('subfield ' + id); }
var EV = [];
[['screen', D.evS], ['heldout', D.evH], ['mesh', D.evM]].forEach(function(p){
  p[1].rows.forEach(function(r){ EV.push({fold:p[0], c:CN[r[0]], o:sub(r[1]), d:sub(r[2]), e:r[3], A:r[4], CT:r[5], tags:r[6], papers:r[7], Y:r[8], pb:r[9], pm:r[10], idx:EV.length}); });
});
var BYF = {screen:[], heldout:[], mesh:[]}; EV.forEach(function(e){ BYF[e.fold].push(e); });
var SORTEDA = {}; Object.keys(BYF).forEach(function(f){ SORTEDA[f] = BYF[f].map(function(e){ return e.A; }).sort(function(a,b){ return a-b; }); });
function pctRank(f, a){ var s = SORTEDA[f], lo = 0, hi = s.length; while(lo < hi){ var m = (lo+hi)>>1; if(s[m] < a) lo = m+1; else hi = m; } return lo / s.length; }
function quant(f, q){ var s = SORTEDA[f]; return s[Math.floor(q * (s.length - 1))]; }
var MODELS = {screen:D.evS, heldout:D.evH, mesh:D.evM};

/* ================================================================ 2. STEPPER */
var exE = D.exEvent, exP = D.exPool;
var exRow = BYF.screen.filter(function(e){ return e.c === exP.phrase && e.e === exE.e && Math.abs(e.A - exE.A_cont) < 1e-4; })[0];
var sd = D.margins.filter(function(r){ return r.test === 'K1_total' && r.fold === 'SCREEN'; })[0];
var cy = Object.keys(exP.screen_counts_by_year).filter(function(k){ return +k >= exP.F; }).map(function(k){ return k + ': ' + exP.screen_counts_by_year[k]; }).join(', ');
var coS = D.fScreen.filter(function(r){ return r.spec === 'coprimary' && r.var === 'A_cont'; })[0];
var STAGES = [
  {short:'Pool', title:'1. An outcome-blind concept pool',
   inn:'<p>Noun phrases first seen in OpenAlex titles and abstracts between 2005 and 2016, with 20 to 300 papers in the first-appearance window.</p><dl class="kv"><dt>Phrase</dt><dd>' + esc(exP.phrase) + '</dd><dt>First year F</dt><dd>' + exP.F + '</dd><dt>Works per year</dt><dd>' + cy + '</dd></dl>',
   doo:'<p>The frame is frozen and hashed before any later data are read (<button type="button" class="term" data-term="outcomeblind">outcome-blind</button>), then a classifier and a variant merger ground every candidate. A hash on the identifier assigns it to a fold.</p>',
   out:'<dl class="kv"><dt>Early volume</dt><dd>' + exP.early_volume_V + ' works</dd><dt>Origin field</dt><dd>' + esc(exP.origin_field) + '</dd><dt>Origin subfield</dt><dd>' + esc(exP.origin_subfield) + '</dd><dt>Fold</dt><dd>Screen</dd></dl>',
   why:'Choosing concepts before seeing how they fared keeps the pool from favouring winners.'},
  {short:'Entry', title:'2. The concept enters a host subfield',
   inn:'<p>Every OpenAlex work that carries the concept, tagged with its subfield and year, and the keywords that co-occur with the concept on those works.</p>',
   doo:'<p>Find the first year the concept appears in each non-origin subfield. Keep the entry only if it arrives with at least five co-occurring partner terms: a <button type="button" class="term" data-term="entry">host-entry event</button>.</p>',
   out:'<dl class="kv"><dt>Host subfield</dt><dd>' + esc(exE.host_subfield) + '</dd><dt>Entry year e</dt><dd>' + exE.e + '</dd><dt>Entry-year papers</dt><dd>' + exE.n_entry_papers + '</dd><dt>Distinct partners</dt><dd>' + exE.n_partners_distinct + '</dd></dl><p class="small">OpenAlex files the topic Quantum Information and Cryptography under its Artificial Intelligence subfield.</p>',
   why:'The unit is the entry, not the concept, so one concept contributes one event per host it reaches.'},
  {short:'Share', title:'3. Score the entry by its partners’ vocabulary',
   inn:'<p>The ' + exE.n_partners_distinct + ' partner terms and, for each one, its exact OpenAlex publication counts by subfield in the years before entry.</p>',
   doo:'<p>For each partner, take its pre-entry share of publications in the host subfield. Average across partners, weighting each co-occurrence edge by association strength. Separately, count how many partners were origin companions: <button type="button" class="term" data-term="ct">co-transfer</button>.</p>',
   out:'<dl class="kv"><dt>Host-vocabulary share</dt><dd>' + fx(exE.A_cont, 3) + '</dd><dt>Rank among Screen entries</dt><dd id="st-rank"></dd><dt>Co-transfer</dt><dd>' + fx(exE.CT, 2) + '</dd><dt>Partners with a profile</dt><dd>' + pct(exE.cov) + '</dd></dl>',
   why:'On the Screen fold the mean share is 0.043 (SD 0.055) and only 1.1% of partner tags have a host share above 50%, so the continuous share, not a native/foreign cut, is the exposure.'},
  {short:'Uptake', title:'4. Count newcomers over the next five years',
   inn:'<p>Host-subfield papers carrying the concept in ' + (exE.e + 1) + ' to ' + (exE.e + 5) + ', with their author lists.</p>',
   doo:'<p>Keep only papers by author-disjoint newcomers: no prior concept paper, no co-authorship with earlier concept authors. That count is <button type="button" class="term" data-term="newcomer">newcomer uptake</button>.</p>',
   out:'<dl class="kv"><dt>Newcomer papers</dt><dd>' + exE.Y_strict + '</dd><dt>All host papers</dt><dd>' + exE.Y_all + '</dd><dt>Rooted</dt><dd>' + (exE.EST_bin ? 'yes' : 'no') + '</dd></dl>',
   why:'Counting only newcomers asks whether the host field itself picked the concept up, rather than whether its original authors kept using it.'},
  {short:'Model', title:'5. Test the share in a pre-registered regression',
   inn:'<p>All ' + nfmt(coS.N) + ' Screen events that survive the fixed effects, each with its share, co-transfer and controls (relatedness, momentum, volume, partner count and others).</p>',
   doo:'<p><button type="button" class="term" data-term="ppml">PPML</button> of newcomer papers on the share and co-transfer with concept, entry-year and host fixed effects (the <button type="button" class="term" data-term="coprimary">co-primary</button> model), clustering by concept.</p>',
   out:'<dl class="kv"><dt>IRR per SD (Screen)</dt><dd>' + f2(coS.est) + ' [' + f2(coS.lo) + ', ' + f2(coS.hi) + ']</dd><dt>This entry, controls only</dt><dd>' + fx(exE.predict_baseline, 1) + ' papers predicted</dd><dt>+ share and co-transfer</dt><dd>' + fx(exE.predict_method, 1) + ' papers predicted</dd><dt>Observed</dt><dd>' + exE.Y_strict + '</dd></dl>',
   why:'The fixed effects compare entries of the same concept, year and host, so the share is not standing in for a popular concept or a busy field. The out-of-fold predictions are descriptive: adding the share moved this entry closer to what happened.'}
];
var stage = 0, pipeHost = document.getElementById('c-pipeline');
function drawPipeline(){
  var W = Math.max(280, Math.floor(pipeHost.clientWidth)), n = STAGES.length, vertical = W < 560;
  var H = vertical ? n * 46 + 6 : 86;
  var svg = newSvg(pipeHost, H, 'Pipeline diagram; current stage ' + (stage + 1) + ' of ' + n + ': ' + STAGES[stage].short);
  var boxW = vertical ? Math.min(W - 4, 360) : (W - (n - 1) * 22) / n, boxH = vertical ? 36 : 56;
  STAGES.forEach(function(s, i){
    var x = vertical ? 2 : i * (boxW + 22), y = vertical ? i * 46 + 2 : 14, cur = i === stage;
    var g = el('g', {'class':'node'}, svg);
    el('rect', {x:x, y:y, width:boxW, height:boxH, rx:8, fill: cur ? 'var(--accent)' : (i < stage ? 'var(--accent-soft)' : '#fff'), stroke: cur ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--line)', 'stroke-width':1.5}, g);
    tx(g, x + (vertical ? 14 : boxW/2), y + (vertical ? 23 : 34), (i + 1) + '. ' + s.short, {'text-anchor': vertical ? 'start' : 'middle', 'font-size':'14', 'font-weight': cur ? '700' : '500', fill: cur ? '#fff' : 'var(--ink)'});
    g.addEventListener('click', function(){ go(i); });
    if(i < n - 1){
      if(vertical) el('path', {d:'M'+(x+20)+' '+(y+boxH+1)+' l0 8', stroke:'#9aa1a9', 'stroke-width':1.5}, svg);
      else { var ax = x + boxW + 3; el('path', {d:'M'+ax+' '+(y+boxH/2)+' l14 0 m-5 -5 l5 5 l-5 5', stroke:'#9aa1a9', 'stroke-width':1.5, fill:'none'}, svg); }
    }
  });
}
var marks = document.getElementById('st-marks');
STAGES.forEach(function(s, i){ var li = document.createElement('li'); var b = document.createElement('button'); b.type='button'; b.textContent = String(i + 1); b.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Stage ' + (i + 1) + ': ' + s.short); b.addEventListener('click', function(){ go(i); }); li.appendChild(b); marks.appendChild(li); });
function go(i){
  stage = Math.max(0, Math.min(STAGES.length - 1, i)); var s = STAGES[stage];
  document.getElementById('st-title').textContent = s.title;
  document.getElementById('st-in').innerHTML = s.inn; document.getElementById('st-do').innerHTML = s.doo; document.getElementById('st-out').innerHTML = s.out;
  document.getElementById('st-why').innerHTML = '<strong>Why.</strong> ' + s.why;
  var rk = document.getElementById('st-rank'); if(rk) rk.textContent = 'higher than ' + pct(pctRank('screen', exE.A_cont)) + ' of ' + nfmt(BYF.screen.length) + ' (computed here)';
  marks.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(function(b, j){ if(j === stage) b.setAttribute('aria-current','step'); else b.removeAttribute('aria-current'); });
  document.getElementById('st-prev').disabled = stage === 0; document.getElementById('st-next').disabled = stage === STAGES.length - 1;
  document.getElementById('st-live').textContent = 'Stage ' + (stage + 1) + ' of ' + STAGES.length + ': ' + s.title;
  document.querySelectorAll('#v-stepper .term').forEach(function(b){ if(!b._def) wireTerm(b); });
  drawPipeline();
}
document.getElementById('st-prev').addEventListener('click', function(){ go(stage - 1); });
document.getElementById('st-next').addEventListener('click', function(){ go(stage + 1); });
document.getElementById('v-stepper').addEventListener('keydown', function(ev){
  if(ev.target.tagName === 'INPUT' || ev.target.tagName === 'SELECT') return;
  if(ev.key === 'ArrowRight'){ go(stage + 1); ev.preventDefault(); } else if(ev.key === 'ArrowLeft'){ go(stage - 1); ev.preventDefault(); }
});

/* ================================================================ 3a. BROWSER */
var B = {fold:'all', q:'', sort:'A_desc', zero:false, page:0, sel:exRow || EV[0], per:10, list:[]};
document.getElementById('browser-intro').textContent = 'All ' + nfmt(EV.length) + ' recorded host-entry events: ' + nfmt(BYF.screen.length) + ' Screen, ' + nfmt(BYF.heldout.length) + ' Held-out and ' + nfmt(BYF.mesh.length) + ' MeSH. The regressions keep the subset with variation inside the fixed effects (' + nfmt(D.fScreen[0].N) + ', ' + nfmt(D.fHeld[0].N) + ' and ' + nfmt(D.fMesh[0].N) + ' events). Pick a row to put its input beside the two models’ predictions and the observed outcome.';
function filterEvents(){
  var q = B.q.trim().toLowerCase();
  var L = EV.filter(function(e){ return (B.fold === 'all' || e.fold === B.fold) && (!B.zero || e.Y === 0) && (!q || e.c.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) >= 0 || e.d.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) >= 0); });
  var k = B.sort;
  L.sort(function(a, b){ if(k === 'A_desc') return b.A - a.A; if(k === 'A_asc') return a.A - b.A; if(k === 'Y_desc') return b.Y - a.Y || b.A - a.A; if(k === 'gain_desc') return (b.pm - b.pb) - (a.pm - a.pb); return a.e - b.e || b.A - a.A; });
  B.list = L;
}
function drawBrowser(keepPage){
  filterEvents(); var L = B.list, pages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(L.length / B.per));
  if(!keepPage) B.page = 0; B.page = Math.min(B.page, pages - 1);
  var nz = L.filter(function(e){ return e.Y > 0; }).length;
  document.getElementById('b-count').innerHTML = '<b>' + nfmt(L.length) + '</b> of ' + nfmt(EV.length) + ' events match; ' + (L.length ? pct(nz / L.length) : '0%') + ' of them drew at least one newcomer paper.';
  var tb = document.getElementById('b-body'); tb.innerHTML = '';
  L.slice(B.page * B.per, B.page * B.per + B.per).forEach(function(e){
    var tr = document.createElement('tr'); if(e === B.sel) tr.className = 'sel';
    tr.innerHTML = '<td><button type="button" class="rowbtn" aria-pressed="' + (e === B.sel) + '">' + esc(e.c) + '</button></td><td>' + esc(e.d) + '</td><td class="num">' + e.e + '</td><td class="num">' + fx(e.A, 3) + '</td><td class="num">' + fx(e.CT, 2) + '</td><td class="num">' + e.Y + '</td><td>' + FOLDNAME[e.fold] + '</td>';
    tr.querySelector('button').addEventListener('click', function(){ B.sel = e; drawBrowser(true); drawDetail(); });
    tb.appendChild(tr);
  });
  if(!L.length){ tb.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="7">No events match. Clear the search or change the fold.</td></tr>'; }
  document.getElementById('b-page').textContent = 'Page ' + (B.page + 1) + ' of ' + pages;
  document.getElementById('b-prev').disabled = B.page === 0; document.getElementById('b-next').disabled = B.page >= pages - 1;
}
function hbars(host, items, o){
  var W = Math.max(280, Math.floor(host.clientWidth)), rowH = o.rowH || 34, H = items.length * rowH + 58;
  var svg = newSvg(host, H, o.aria);
  var labW = Math.ceil(measure(svg, items.map(function(i){ return i.label; }), 'lab')) + 12;
  var valW = Math.ceil(measure(svg, items.map(function(i){ return i.val; }), 'val')) + 10;
  var narrowLab = labW > W * 0.45;
  if(narrowLab){ rowH = rowH + 16; H = items.length * rowH + 58; svg.setAttribute('height', H); svg.setAttribute('viewBox', '0 0 ' + W + ' ' + H); labW = 0; }
  var x0 = labW + 4, x1 = W - valW - 6, max = o.max || Math.max.apply(null, items.map(function(i){ return i.v; })) || 1;
  var sc = function(v){ return x0 + v / max * (x1 - x0); };
  var ticks = niceTicks(0, max, W < 500 ? 3 : 5).filter(function(t){ return t <= max + 1e-9; });
  var axisTop = items.length * rowH + 4;
  drawXAxis(svg, sc, ticks, 0, axisTop, x0, x1, o.xlabel, o.tickFmt || function(t){ return String(t); }, null);
  if(o.refLine !== undefined && o.refLine !== null){ el('line', {x1:sc(o.refLine), x2:sc(o.refLine), y1:0, y2:axisTop, 'class':'nulll'}, svg); }
  items.forEach(function(it, i){
    var y = i * rowH, by = narrowLab ? y + 20 : y + 7, bh = rowH - (narrowLab ? 26 : 14);
    if(narrowLab) tx(svg, 0, y + 14, it.label, {'class':'lab', style:'font-size:13px'}); else tx(svg, 0, by + bh/2 + 5, it.label, {'class':'lab'});
    var g = el('g', {}, svg);
    el('rect', {x:x0 - 2, y:by - 3, width:(x1 - x0) + valW + 4, height:bh + 6, 'class':'hit'}, g);
    el('rect', {x:x0, y:by, width:Math.max(1, sc(it.v) - x0), height:bh, fill:it.color, rx:2}, g);
    tx(g, sc(it.v) + 5, by + bh/2 + 5, it.val, {'class':'val'});
    markify(g, it.label + ': ' + it.val, it.tip);
  });
}
function drawDetail(){
  var e = B.sel; if(!e) return; var m = MODELS[e.fold];
  document.getElementById('d-input').innerHTML =
    '<dt>Concept</dt><dd>' + esc(e.c) + '</dd><dt>Origin subfield</dt><dd>' + esc(e.o) + '</dd><dt>Host subfield</dt><dd>' + esc(e.d) + '</dd><dt>Entry year</dt><dd>' + e.e + '</dd>' +
    '<dt>Entry-year papers</dt><dd>' + e.papers + '</dd><dt>Partner tags</dt><dd>' + e.tags + '</dd><dt>Host-vocabulary share</dt><dd>' + fx(e.A, 3) + ' (above ' + pct(pctRank(e.fold, e.A)) + ' of ' + FOLDNAME[e.fold] + ' entries)</dd>' +
    '<dt>Co-transfer</dt><dd>' + fx(e.CT, 2) + '</dd><dt>Fold</dt><dd>' + FOLDNAME[e.fold] + '</dd>';
  var mx = Math.max(e.pb, e.pm, e.Y, 1);
  hbars(document.getElementById('c-detail'), [
    {label:'Baseline prediction', v:e.pb, val:fx(e.pb, 1), color:'var(--base)', tip:'<b>Baseline</b>: ' + esc(m.baseline) + '<br>' + fx(e.pb, 2) + ' newcomer papers'},
    {label:'Method prediction', v:e.pm, val:fx(e.pm, 1), color:'var(--accent)', tip:'<b>Method</b>: ' + esc(m.method) + '<br>' + fx(e.pm, 2) + ' newcomer papers'},
    {label:'Observed', v:e.Y, val:String(e.Y), color:'var(--ink)', tip:'<b>Observed</b> newcomer papers in ' + (e.e + 1) + '–' + (e.e + 5) + ': ' + e.Y}
  ], {xlabel:'Newcomer papers in five years', max:mx, aria:'Predicted and observed newcomer papers for the selected entry'});
  document.getElementById('d-models').textContent = 'Baseline: ' + m.baseline + '. Method: ' + m.method + '. Recorded predictions, descriptive only; the inferential test is the regression.';
  var dir = e.pm > e.pb ? 'raised' : (e.pm < e.pb ? 'lowered' : 'left unchanged');
  var closer = Math.abs(e.pm - e.Y) < Math.abs(e.pb - e.Y);
  document.getElementById('t-browser').textContent = 'For ' + e.c + ' entering ' + e.d + ' in ' + e.e + ', adding the host-vocabulary share and co-transfer ' + dir + ' the predicted newcomer count from ' + fx(e.pb, 1) + ' to ' + fx(e.pm, 1) + '; ' + e.Y + ' arrived, so the method prediction is ' + (closer ? 'closer to' : 'further from') + ' the outcome.';
}
document.getElementById('b-fold').addEventListener('change', function(){ B.fold = this.value; drawBrowser(); });
document.getElementById('b-q').addEventListener('input', function(){ B.q = this.value; drawBrowser(); });
document.getElementById('b-sort').addEventListener('change', function(){ B.sort = this.value; drawBrowser(); });
document.getElementById('b-zero').addEventListener('change', function(){ B.zero = this.checked; drawBrowser(); });
document.getElementById('b-prev').addEventListener('click', function(){ B.page--; drawBrowser(true); });
document.getElementById('b-next').addEventListener('click', function(){ B.page++; drawBrowser(true); });
function openInBrowser(e){
  B.fold = e.fold; B.q = e.c; B.zero = false; B.sel = e; B.sort = 'A_desc';
  document.getElementById('b-fold').value = e.fold; document.getElementById('b-q').value = e.c; document.getElementById('b-zero').checked = false; document.getElementById('b-sort').value = 'A_desc';
  filterEvents(); var i = B.list.indexOf(e); B.page = Math.max(0, Math.floor(i / B.per)); drawBrowser(true); drawDetail();

/* ================================================================ 3b. CASES */
var CASES = {}; D.cases.forEach(function(r){ (CASES[r.phrase] = CASES[r.phrase] || []).push(r); });
var CASEORDER = Object.keys(CASES), caseSel = CASEORDER[0];
var cp = document.getElementById('cs-pick');
CASEORDER.forEach(function(p, i){ var l = document.createElement('label'); l.innerHTML = '<input type="radio" name="case" value="' + esc(p) + '"' + (i === 0 ? ' checked' : '') + '><span>' + esc(p) + '</span>'; cp.appendChild(l); });
cp.addEventListener('change', function(ev){ caseSel = ev.target.value; drawCases(); });
document.getElementById('cs-all').addEventListener('change', drawCases);
function drawCases(){
  var all = document.getElementById('cs-all').checked, rs = CASES[caseSel];
  var use = rs.filter(function(r){ return (all || r.coprimary) && r.A !== null; }).sort(function(a, b){ return b.A - a.A; });
  var noA = rs.filter(function(r){ return (all || r.coprimary) && r.A === null; }).length;
  var nr = use.filter(function(r){ return !r.rooted; }), mean = nr.length ? nr.reduce(function(s, r){ return s + r.A; }, 0) / nr.length : null;
  var mx = Math.max.apply(null, use.map(function(r){ return r.A; }).concat([0.02]));
  hbars(document.getElementById('c-cases'), use.map(function(r){
    return {label: r.host + ', ' + r.e + (r.coprimary ? '' : ' *'), v:r.A, val:fx(r.A, 3) + (r.rooted ? ' · ' + r.Y + ' newcomers' : ''), color: r.rooted ? 'var(--mesh)' : 'var(--base)',
      tip:'<b>' + esc(r.host) + ', ' + r.e + '</b><br>Host share ' + fx(r.A, 3) + ' · co-transfer ' + (r.CT === null ? 'n/a' : fx(r.CT, 2)) + '<br>' + r.Y + ' newcomer papers · ' + (r.rooted ? 'rooted' : 'not rooted') + '<br>' + r.papers + ' entry-year paper(s), ' + r.partners + ' partners' + (r.coprimary ? '' : '<br>outside the co-primary sample')};
  }), {xlabel:'Host-vocabulary share (fraction)', max:mx * 1.05, refLine:mean, rowH:30, aria:'Host entries of ' + caseSel + ' by host-vocabulary share'});
  var cl = rs[0].cluster;
  document.getElementById('cs-note').textContent = 'Typology: ' + cl + '. ' + use.length + ' entr' + (use.length === 1 ? 'y' : 'ies') + ' shown' + (all ? ' (* = outside the co-primary sample)' : ' from the co-primary sample') + (noA ? '; ' + noA + ' more ha' + (noA === 1 ? 's' : 've') + ' no recorded share' : '') + '. Rooted means at least five newcomer papers in at least three of five years.';
  var rooted = use.filter(function(r){ return r.rooted; }), t;
  if(!rooted.length) t = 'None of the ' + use.length + ' entries of ' + caseSel + ' took root (mean share ' + fx(mean, 3) + '), including ' + use[0].host + ' at ' + fx(use[0].A, 3) + ': a high share is no guarantee.';
  else if(!nr.length) t = caseSel + ' has only rooted entries here (' + rooted.map(function(r){ return r.host + ' ' + fx(r.A, 3); }).join(', ') + '), so there is no within-concept contrast.';
  else { var top = rooted.every(function(r){ return nr.every(function(n){ return r.A > n.A; }); });
    t = 'In ' + caseSel + ', the rooted entr' + (rooted.length > 1 ? 'ies (' : 'y (') + rooted.map(function(r){ return r.host + ', ' + r.e + ', ' + fx(r.A, 3); }).join('; ') + ') ' + (top ? 'sit' + (rooted.length > 1 ? '' : 's') + ' above every one of the ' + nr.length + ' non-rooted entries' : 'do not all sit above the non-rooted entries') + ' (non-rooted mean ' + fx(mean, 3) + ').'; }
  document.getElementById('t-cases').textContent = t;
}

/* ================================================================ 3c. MECHANISM */
var mTab = 'margins';
function mrow(test, fold, outcome){ return D.margins.filter(function(r){ return r.test === test && r.fold === fold && (!outcome || r.outcome === outcome); })[0]; }
var FOLDK = [['SCREEN','Screen'], ['HELDOUT','Held-out'], ['MESH','MeSH']];
function drawMech(){
  var c1 = document.getElementById('c-mech'), c2 = document.getElementById('c-mech2'), note = document.getElementById('m-note'), t = document.getElementById('t-mech');
  document.getElementById('m-ladder-ctl').hidden = mTab !== 'ladder';
  c2.innerHTML = '';

    rows.push({label:'IVW pooled', est:I.ext, lo:I.ext_ci[0], hi:I.ext_ci[1], color:'var(--pool)', shape:'diamond', val:f2(I.ext) + ' [' + f2(I.ext_ci[0]) + ', ' + f2(I.ext_ci[1]) + ']', tip:'<b>IVW pooled extensive margin</b><br>' + f2(I.ext) + ' pp per SD [' + f2(I.ext_ci[0]) + ', ' + f2(I.ext_ci[1]) + ']<br>randomisation-t p = ' + fP(I.ext_p_rand_t)});
    forest(c1, rows, {log:false, min:0, max:0, nullAt:0, xlabel:'Percentage points per SD of host-vocabulary share', tickFmt:function(v){ return String(v); }, aria:'Extensive margin by fold'});
    var rows2 = [{type:'group', label:'Intensive: how much, once started?'}];
    FOLDK.forEach(function(f){ var r = mrow('K1b', f[0]); rows2.push({label:f[1], est:r.est, lo:r.lo, hi:r.hi, color:'var(--accent)', val:fx(r.est, 3) + ' [' + fx(r.lo, 3) + ', ' + fx(r.hi, 3) + ']', tip:'<b>' + f[1] + ', intensive margin</b><br>PPML on Y ≥ 1, IRR per SD: ' + fx(r.est, 3) + ' [' + fx(r.lo, 3) + ', ' + fx(r.hi, 3) + ']<br>N ' + nfmt(r.N) + ', G ' + r.G}); });
    rows2.push({label:'IVW pooled', est:I.int, lo:I.int_ci[0], hi:I.int_ci[1], color:'var(--pool)', shape:'diamond', val:fx(I.int, 3) + ' [' + fx(I.int_ci[0], 3) + ', ' + fx(I.int_ci[1], 3) + ']', tip:'<b>IVW pooled intensive margin</b><br>IRR per SD ' + fx(I.int, 3) + ' [' + fx(I.int_ci[0], 3) + ', ' + fx(I.int_ci[1], 3) + ']'});
    forest(c2, rows2, {log:true, min:1, max:1, nullAt:1, xlabel:'IRR per SD, conditional on uptake (log scale)', aria:'Intensive margin by fold'});
    note.innerHTML = '<button type="button" class="term" data-term="extensive">Extensive margin</button>: linear probability model on any newcomer paper. <button type="button" class="term" data-term="intensive">Intensive margin</button>: PPML among entries with at least one; this conditions on an outcome, so it is descriptive.';
    t.textContent = 'Both margins move: the pooled effect is +' + f2(I.ext) + ' percentage points per SD on whether uptake starts, and an IRR of ' + fx(I.int, 3) + ' on its size once started. The extensive margin carries ' + pct(I.ext_share) + ' of the total (95% CI ' + pct(I.ext_share_ci[0]) + ' to ' + pct(I.ext_share_ci[1]) + ').';
  } else if(mTab === 'ladder'){
    var fk = document.querySelector('input[name=lfold]:checked').value, fname = FOLDK.filter(function(f){ return f[0] === fk; })[0][1];

    var rows3 = [], nulls = [];

'var(--base)' : 'var(--accent)', val:f2(r.est) + ' [' + f2(r.lo) + ', ' + f2(r.hi) + ']', tip:'<b>' + fname + ': ' + o[1] + '</b><br>' + f2(r.est) + ' pp per SD [' + f2(r.lo) + ', ' + f2(r.hi) + ']<br>p = ' + fP(r.p) + ' · base rate ' + pct(r.base)}); });
    forest(c1, rows3, {log:false, min:0, max:0, nullAt:0, xlabel:'Percentage points per SD of host-vocabulary share', aria:'Effect by uptake threshold, ' + fname});

    var est = mrow('K1d_ladder', fk, 'EST_bin');

For rooting, ' + f2(est.est) + ' pp per SD with p = ' + fP(est.p) + ': the gradient is graded, not a threshold.') : ('On ' + fname + ', every bar from one newcomer paper up to rooting shows a positive effect; rooting moves by ' + f2(est.est) + ' pp per SD (p = ' + fP(est.p) + ').');
  } else {

    var rows4 = [{type:'group', label:'Prior exposure of adopters'}];
    A.rows.forEach(function(r, i){ if(i === 3) rows4.push({type:'group', label:'By partner vocabulary class'});
      var neg = r.hi < 1; rows4.push({label:LAB[r.key], est:r.OR, lo:r.lo, hi:r.hi, color: neg ? 'var(--base)' : 'var(--accent)', val:f2(r.OR) + ' [' + f2(r.lo) + ', ' + f2(r.hi) + ']', tip:'<b>' + LAB[r.key] + '</b><br>odds ratio ' + f2(r.OR) + ', bootstrap 95% CI [' + f2(r.lo) + ', ' + f2(r.hi) + ']'}); });

Classes: <button type="button" class="term" data-term="vocabclass">FOREIGN, ADJACENT, NATIVE</button>.';
    var r0 = A.rows[0], rf = A.rows[3], rn = A.rows[5];
    t.textContent = 'Adopters are enriched for prior exposure to the concept’s own entry partners (OR ' + f2(r0.OR) + '; prevalence ' + f2(A.prev_case) + ' vs ' + f2(A.prev_control) + '), most for FOREIGN partners (' + f2(rf.OR) + ') and least for NATIVE ones (' + f2(rn.OR) + '): the people who cross already speak the origin language.';
  }
  document.querySelectorAll('#v-mech .term').forEach(function(b){ if(!b._def) wireTerm(b); });

var tabs = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('#m-tabs [role=tab]'));
function selTab(b, focus){ tabs.forEach(function(x){ var on = x === b; x.setAttribute('aria-selected', on); x.tabIndex = on ? 0 : -1; }); document.getElementById('m-panel').setAttribute('aria-labelledby', b.id); mTab = b.id.replace('tab-', '').replace('adopt','adopt'); if(focus) b.focus(); drawMech(); }

content</a>\n<header class=\"top\">\n  <div class=\"wrap\">\n    <h1>Host vocabulary predicts whether new scientific concepts take root across disciplinary boundaries</h1>\n    <p class=\"author\">Single-author paper (the manuscript gives no author name). Interactive companion built from the run's recorded outputs.</p>\n    <div class=\"links\">\n      <a class=\"btn primary\" href=\"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8892b7-occupancy-is-not-integration-for-new@fork/run_-5obKGrJFD0H/paper.pdf\">Read the paper (PDF)</a>\n      <a class=\"btn\" href=\"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8892b7-occupancy-is-not-integration-for-new@fork/run_-5obKGrJFD0H/report.pdf\">Read the full research report</a>\n      <a class=\"btn\" href=\"https://github.com/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8892b7-occupancy-is-not-integration-for-new/tree/fork/run_-5obKGrJFD0H\">Code repository</a>\n    </div>\n  </div>\n</header>\n<nav class=\"sections\" aria-label=\"Sections\">\n  <ul>\n    <li><a href=\"#finding\">The finding</a></li>\n    <li><a href=\"#how\">How it works</a></li>\n    <li><a href=\"#evidence\">Explore the evidence</a></li>\n    <li><a href=\"#try\">Try it</a></li>\n    <li><a href=\"#fails\">Where it fails</a></li>\n    <li><a href=\"#about\">Sources and glossary</a></li>\n  </ul>\n</nav>\n<div id=\"tip\" role=\"status\" aria-live=\"off\"></div>\n<main id=\"main\">\n\n<!-- ============================================================ FINDING -->\n<section class=\"block\" id=\"finding\" aria-labelledby=\"h-finding\">\n<div class=\"wrap\">\n  <h2 id=\"h-finding\">The finding</h2>\n  <div class=\"grid2\">\n    <div class=\"prose\">\n      <p class=\"lede\"><strong>The question.</strong> When a new scientific concept first shows up in a subfield outside its home, most such entries fade. Which ones take root?</p>\n      <p><strong>The answer.</strong> Look at the words the concept arrives with. The study measures, for each <button type=\"button\" class=\"term\" data-term=\"entry\">host-entry event</button>, the <button type=\"button\" class=\"term\" data-term=\"share\">host-vocabulary share</button> of its partner terms, and asks whether it predicts <button type=\"button\" class=\"term\" data-term=\"newcomer\">newcomer uptake</button> over the next five years.</p>\n      <p class=\"big\" id=\"big-number\" aria-describedby=\"big-cap\"></p>\n      <p class=\"bigcap\" id=\"big-cap\"></p>\n      <p>Arriving as an imported package does not help: <button type=\"button\" class=\"term\" data-term=\"ct\">co-transfer</button> of origin companions is null in every fold. The Screen and Held-out folds give concordant estimates, but both were used in pipeline development, so the independent evidence is the MeSH replication.</p>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"view\" id=\"v-forest\" aria-labelledby=\"q-forest\">\n      <p class=\"q\" id=\"q-forest\">Does the effect hold in every fold and under both pre-registered specifications?</p>\n      <div class=\"controls\">\n        <fieldset>\n          <legend>Specification</legend>\n          <div class=\"seg\" role=\"radiogroup\" aria-label=\"Specification\">\n            <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"spec\" value=\"coprimary\" checked><span>Co-primary</span></label>\n            <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"spec\" value=\"primary\"><span>Primary (strict FE)</span></label>\n          </div>\n        </fieldset>\n        <fieldset>\n          <legend>Show</legend>\n          <label class=\"chk\"><input type=\"checkbox\" id=\"f-ct\" checked> Co-transfer rows</label>\n        </fieldset>\n      </div>\n      <fieldset class=\"controls\" style=\"margin-top:-4px\">\n        <legend class=\"visually-hidden\">Folds shown</legend>\n        <label class=\"chk\"><input type=\"checkbox\" class=\"f-fold\" value=\"screen\" checked> Screen</label>\n        <label class=\"chk\"><input type=\"checkbox\" class=\"f-fold\" value=\"heldout\" checked> Held-out</label>\n        <label class=\"chk\"><input type=\"checkbox\" class=\"f-fold\" value=\"mesh\" checked> MeSH</label>\n        <label class=\"chk\"><input type=\"checkbox\" class=\"f-fold\" value=\"ivw\" checked> Pooled (IVW)</label>\n      </fieldset>\n      <div class=\"chart\" id=\"c-forest\"></div>\n      <div class=\"legend\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\n        <span><i class=\"sw dot\" style=\"background:var(--accent)\"></i>Host-vocabulary share</span>\n        <span><i class=\"sw dot\" style=\"background:var(--base)\"></i>Co-transfer (competing channel)</span>\n        <span><i class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--pool);transform:rotate(45deg);width:11px;height:11px\"></i>IVW pooled</span>\n        <span><i class=\"sw dash\"></i>IRR = 1, no effect</span>\n      </div>\n      <p class=\"note\"><button type=\"button\" class=\"term\" data-term=\"irr\">IRR per SD</button> from <button type=\"button\" class=\"term\" data-term=\"ppml\">PPML</button> with concept-clustered 95% CIs, log axis. Point at a mark for its N, clusters and p-value.</p>\n      <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"t-forest\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n    </div>\n  </div>\n</div>\n</section>\n\n<!-- ============================================================ HOW -->\n<section class=\"block\" id=\"how\" aria-labelledby=\"h-how\">\n<div class=\"wrap\">\n  <h2 id=\"h-how\">How it works</h2>\n  <p class=\"prose\">The study has four stages: an outcome-blind concept pool, yearly co-word networks, host-entry events scored by their partners' vocabulary, and a pre-registered regression on five-year newcomer uptake. The stepper below follows one real entry from the recorded data through the RQ2 pipeline.</p>\n  <figure>\n    <img src=\"figures/fig1_v0.jpg\" alt=\"Four-panel study design: (a) the 426-concept arXiv pool split into Screen and Held-out folds and the 191-concept MeSH check population, drawn from 462,812 OpenAlex works; (b) a co-word network with Leiden communities; (c) the matched event study for emergence precursors; (d) host-entry grafting, where a concept enters a host subfield with host-native and origin partner terms and the host-vocabulary share predicts five-year newcomer uptake.\" width=\"1400\" height=\"601\" loading=\"lazy\">\n    <figcaption>Overview of the study design. (a) Data: an outcome-blind arXiv concept pool of 426 emerging scientific concepts, split into a screen fold (247) and a held-out fold (119), and an independent MeSH biomedical check population of 191 concepts. Both are drawn from 462,812 OpenAlex works. (b) Co-word network: yearly co-word snapshots (25 snapshots, ~27k nodes, ~84k edges) with Leiden communities; the schematic shows three colour-coded communities. (c) RQ1, emergence precursors: a matched event study compares closure measures in the pre-onset window (shaded) between concepts showing sustained uptake (blue, rising after onset) and controls (grey, flat). (d) RQ2, host-entry grafting: a concept enters a non-origin host subfield (light blue → light green region). Its partner terms are either host-native (dark green) or from the origin vocabulary (light blue). The host-vocabulary share (orange) is the exposure in a pre-registered PPML regression with concept-clustered standard errors predicting 5-year newcomer uptake. The timelines and bars in (c) and (d) are schematic and carry no data values.</figcaption>\n  </figure>\n  <div class=\"view\" id=\"v-stepper\" aria-labelledby=\"q-stepper\">\n    <p class=\"q\" id=\"q-stepper\">What happens to one concept on its way from first appearance to a measured effect?</p>\n    <div class=\"chart\" id=\"c-pipeline\" aria-hidden=\"false\"></div>\n    <div class=\"stepnav\">\n      <button type=\"button\" class=\"navbtn\" id=\"st-prev\">← Previous</button>\n      <ol class=\"stepmarks\" id=\"st-marks\" aria-label=\"Stages\"></ol>\n      <button type=\"button\" class=\"navbtn\" id=\"st-next\">Next →</button>\n    </div>\n    <p class=\"visually-hidden\" id=\"st-live\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n    <h3 id=\"st-title\"></h3>\n    <div class=\"stagecard\">\n      <div class=\"cell\"><h4>What goes in</h4><div id=\"st-in\"></div></div>\n      <div class=\"cell\"><h4>What is done</h4><div id=\"st-do\"></div></div>\n      <div class=\"cell\"><h4>What comes out</h4><div id=\"st-out\"></div></div>\n    </div>\n    <p class=\"why\" id=\"st-why\"></p>\n    <p class=\"note\">Use the arrow keys while focus is inside this panel to move between stages.</p>\n  </div>\n</div>\n</section>\n\n<!-- ============================================================ EVIDENCE -->\n<section class=\"block\" id=\"evidence\" aria-labelledby=\"h-evidence\">\n<div class=\"wrap\">\n  <h2 id=\"h-evidence\">Explore the evidence</h2>\n\n  <div class=\"view\" id=\"v-browser\" aria-labelledby=\"q-browser\">\n    <p class=\"q\" id=\"q-browser\">What did individual entries look like, and did knowing their host-vocabulary share change the prediction?</p>\n    <p class=\"prose small\" id=\"browser-intro\"></p>\n    <div class=\"controls\">\n      <label>Fold <select id=\"b-fold\"><option value=\"all\">All three</option><option value=\"screen\">Screen</option><option value=\"heldout\">Held-out</option><option value=\"mesh\">MeSH</option></select></label>\n      <label>Search <input type=\"search\" id=\"b-q\" placeholder=\"concept or subfield\" aria-describedby=\"b-count\"></label>\n      <label>Sort <select id=\"b-sort\">\n        <option value=\"A_desc\">Host share, high to low</option>\n        <option value=\"A_asc\">Host share, low to high</option>\n        <option value=\"Y_desc\">Newcomer papers, most first</option>\n        <option value=\"gain_desc\">Prediction gain, largest first</option>\n        <option value=\"e_asc\">Entry year, earliest first</option>\n      </select></label>\n      <label class=\"chk\"><input type=\"checkbox\" id=\"b-zero\"> Only entries with no newcomer uptake</label>\n    </div>\n    <p class=\"count\" id=\"b-count\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n    <div class=\"tablewrap\">\n      <table>\n        <caption class=\"visually-hidden\">Host-entry events matching the current filters</caption>\n        <thead><tr><th scope=\"col\">Concept</th><th scope=\"col\">Host subfield</th><th scope=\"col\" class=\"num\">Year</th><th scope=\"col\" class=\"num\">Host share</th><th scope=\"col\" class=\"num\">Co-transfer</th><th scope=\"col\" class=\"num\">Newcomer papers</th><th scope=\"col\">Fold</th></tr></thead>\n        <tbody id=\"b-body\"></tbody>\n      </table>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"pager\"><button type=\"button\" class=\"navbtn\" id=\"b-prev\">← Previous page</button><span id=\"b-page\" class=\"small\"></span><button type=\"button\" class=\"navbtn\" id=\"b-next\">Next page →</button></div>\n    <div class=\"detail\" id=\"b-detail\" aria-live=\"polite\">\n      <div class=\"cell\"><h4>Input: the entry as recorded</h4><dl class=\"kv\" id=\"d-input\"></dl></div>\n      <div class=\"cell\"><h4>Baseline vs method vs outcome</h4><div class=\"chart\" id=\"c-detail\"></div><p class=\"note\" id=\"d-models\"></p></div>\n    </div>\n    <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"t-browser\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n  </div>\n\n  <div class=\"view\" id=\"v-cases\" aria-labelledby=\"q-cases\">\n    <p class=\"q\" id=\"q-cases\">Within one concept, is the entry that took root the one with the most host vocabulary?</p>\n    <div class=\"controls\">\n      <fieldset><legend>Concept (typology medoid)</legend>\n      <div class=\"seg\" role=\"radiogroup\" aria-label=\"Concept\" id=\"cs-pick\"></div></fieldset>\n      <label class=\"chk\"><input type=\"checkbox\" id=\"cs-all\"> Include entries outside the co-primary sample</label>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"chart\" id=\"c-cases\"></div>\n    <div class=\"legend\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\n      <span><i class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--mesh)\"></i><span>Rooted entry</span></span>\n      <span><i class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--base)\"></i>Not rooted</span>\n      <span><i class=\"sw dash\"></i>Mean share of non-rooted entries</span>\n    </div>\n    <p class=\"note\" id=\"cs-note\"></p>\n    <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"t-cases\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n  </div>\n\n  <div class=\"view\" id=\"v-mech\" aria-labelledby=\"q-mech\">\n    <p class=\"q\" id=\"q-mech\">Does host vocabulary start uptake, grow it, or both, and who are the adopters?</p>\n    <div class=\"tabs\" role=\"tablist\" aria-label=\"Mechanism views\" id=\"m-tabs\">\n      <button type=\"button\" role=\"tab\" id=\"tab-margins\" aria-controls=\"m-panel\" aria-selected=\"true\">Start or grow</button>\n      <button type=\"button\" role=\"tab\" id=\"tab-ladder\" aria-controls=\"m-panel\" aria-selected=\"false\" tabindex=\"-1\">How high is the bar</button>\n      <button type=\"button\" role=\"tab\" id=\"tab-adopt\" aria-controls=\"m-panel\" aria-selected=\"false\" tabindex=\"-1\">Who adopts</button>\n    </div>\n    <div id=\"m-panel\" role=\"tabpanel\" aria-labelledby=\"tab-margins\">\n      <div class=\"controls\" id=\"m-ladder-ctl\" hidden>\n        <fieldset><legend>Fold</legend>\n        <div class=\"seg\" role=\"radiogroup\" aria-label=\"Fold for the threshold ladder\">\n          <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"lfold\" value=\"SCREEN\" checked><span>Screen</span></label>\n          <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"lfold\" value=\"HELDOUT\"><span>Held-out</span></label>\n          <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"lfold\" value=\"MESH\"><span>MeSH</span></label>\n        </div></fieldset>\n      </div>\n      <div class=\"chart\" id=\"c-mech\"></div>\n      <div class=\"chart\" id=\"c-mech2\"></div>\n      <p class=\"note\" id=\"m-note\"></p>\n    </div>\n    <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"t-mech\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n  </div>\n</div>\n</section>\n\n<!-- ============================================================ TRY -->\n<section class=\"block\" id=\"try\" aria-labelledby=\"h-try\">\n<div class=\"wrap\">\n  <h2 id=\"h-try\">Try it: move the cut on host-vocabulary share</h2>\n  <div class=\"view\" id=\"v-whatif\" aria-labelledby=\"q-whatif\">\n    <p class=\"q\" id=\"q-whatif\">If you split the recorded entries at a host-share cut, how much more often do the high-share entries draw newcomers?</p>\n    <p class=\"prose small\">This view recomputes, live, from the recorded events: no model, no fixed effects, no controls. It shows the raw gradient the regression then tests within concept, year and host. Points with fewer than 10 events on either side are not drawn.</p>\n    <div class=\"controls\">\n      <div class=\"rangebox\"><label for=\"w-cut\">Host-share cut</label><input type=\"range\" id=\"w-cut\" min=\"0\" max=\"0.2\" step=\"0.005\" value=\"0.05\" aria-describedby=\"w-cut-val\"><output id=\"w-cut-val\" class=\"rangeval\" for=\"w-cut\">0.050</output></div>\n      <label>Fold <select id=\"w-fold\"><option value=\"screen\">Screen</option><option value=\"heldout\">Held-out</option><option value=\"mesh\">MeSH</option></select></label>\n      <fieldset><legend>Count an entry as taken up when newcomer papers are at least</legend>\n        <div class=\"seg\" role=\"radiogroup\" aria-label=\"Uptake threshold\">\n          <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"wk\" value=\"1\" checked><span>1</span></label>\n          <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"wk\" value=\"3\"><span>3</span></label>\n          <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"wk\" value=\"5\"><span>5</span></label>\n        </div></fieldset>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"chart\" id=\"c-whatif\"></div>\n    <div class=\"legend\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\n      <span><i class=\"sw dot\" style=\"background:var(--accent)\"></i>Entries at or above the cut</span>\n      <span><i class=\"sw dot\" style=\"background:var(--base)\"></i>Entries below the cut (baseline)</span>\n      <span><i class=\"sw dash\"></i>Current cut</span>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"readout\" id=\"w-read\" aria-live=\"polite\"></div>\n    <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"t-whatif\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n  </div>\n</div>\n</section>\n\n<!-- ============================================================ FAILS -->\n<section class=\"block\" id=\"fails\" aria-labelledby=\"h-fails\">\n<div class=\"wrap\">\n  <h2 id=\"h-fails\">Where it fails</h2>\n  <div class=\"view\" id=\"v-fail\" aria-labelledby=\"q-fail\">\n    <p class=\"q\" id=\"q-fail\">How often does the gradient miss on single entries?</p>\n    <div class=\"toggles\" role=\"group\" aria-label=\"Failure slice\">\n      <button type=\"button\" class=\"toggle\" data-slice=\"high0\" aria-pressed=\"true\">High share, no newcomers</button>\n      <button type=\"button\" class=\"toggle\" data-slice=\"low10\" aria-pressed=\"false\">Low share, 10+ newcomers anyway</button>\n    </div>\n    <p class=\"note\" id=\"fl-def\"></p>\n    <div class=\"chart\" id=\"c-fail\"></div>\n    <ul class=\"fail-list\" id=\"fl-list\"></ul>\n    <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"t-fail\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n  </div>\n\n  <div class=\"view\" id=\"v-field\" aria-labelledby=\"q-field\">\n    <p class=\"q\" id=\"q-field\">Is there a field where the effect disappears?</p>\n    <div class=\"chart\" id=\"c-field\"></div>\n    <p class=\"note\" id=\"fd-note\"></p>\n    <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"t-field\"></p>\n  </div>\n\n  <div class=\"view\" id=\"v-closure\" aria-labelledby=\"q-closure\">\n    <p class=\"q\" id=\"q-closure\">Did the structural precursor story (RQ1) survive?</p>\n    <div class=\"controls\">\n      <fieldset><legend>Estimate</legend>\n      <div class=\"seg\" role=\"radiogroup\" aria-label=\"Closure estimator\">\n        <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"cl\" value=\"es_ho\" checked><span>Held-out event study</span></label>\n        <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"cl\" value=\"pan_ho\"><span>Held-out panel</span></label>\n        <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"cl\" value=\"es_scr\"><span>Screen event study</span></label>\n      </div></fieldset>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"chart\" id=\"c-closure\"></div>\n    <p class=\"note\" id=\"cl-note\"></p>\n    <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"t-closure\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n  </div>\n\n  <div class=\"prose\">\n    <h3>What the paper does not show</h3>\n    <ul class=\"limits\">\n      <li><strong>No true held-out test on the main arm.</strong> The Held-out fold was used during pipeline development, so its estimates are development-set estimates. The independent evidence is the MeSH replication.</li>\n      <li><strong>The strict specification is underpowered.</strong> With concept-by-year and host-by-year fixed effects, the Held-out estimate keeps 250 of 972 events in 30 clusters and is inconclusive (IRR 0.98, 95% CI 0.70 to 1.37).</li>\n      <li><strong>Population bias.</strong> The pool is dominated by physics, physical-sciences and computer-science concepts from arXiv, and MeSH covers only biomedicine-to-biomedicine entries. Social sciences, humanities and engineering are untested.</li>\n      <li><strong>Single-paper entries.</strong> 87% of co-primary Screen events involve a single entry-year paper. The pooled multi-team effect is positive (IRR 1.28, 95% CI 1.11 to 1.48), but the Held-out fold alone is underpowered for this test.</li>\n      <li><strong>Graded, not a threshold.</strong> Binary establishment (at least five newcomer papers in at least three of five years) is null on the Held-out fold (p = 0.16).</li>\n      <li><strong>Cluster-robust p-values over-reject.</strong> The estimator rejects 10% to 11% of null shuffles in simulation (target 5%). Wild-cluster and permutation tests agree (Held-out wild p = 0.012, permutation p = 0.026).</li>\n      <li><strong>Host-specificity is weakly tested.</strong> The Balassa-index lift has a within-fixed-effect correlation of 0.997 with the log of the continuous share, so it confirms the share rather than adding independent evidence.</li>\n      <li><strong>Adopter evidence is Screen-fold only.</strong> The enrichment (OR 3.09) is not independently confirmed and cannot separate absorptive capacity from topical proximity.</li>\n    </ul>\n  </div>\n</div>\n</section>\n</main>\n\n<!-- ============================================================ FOOTER -->\n<footer id=\"about\" aria-labelledby=\"h-about\">\n<div class=\"wrap\">\n  <h2 id=\"h-about\" style=\"margin-top:0\">Sources and glossary</h2>\n  <div class=\"links\">\n    <a class=\"btn primary\" href=\"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8892b7-occupancy-is-not-integration-for-new@fork/run_-5obKGrJFD0H/paper.pdf\">Read the paper (PDF)</a>\n    <a class=\"btn\" href=\"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8892b7-occupancy-is-not-integration-for-new@fork/run_-5obKGrJFD0H/report.pdf\">Read the full research report</a>\n    <a class=\"btn\" href=\"https://github.com/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8892b7-occupancy-is-not-integration-for-new/tree/fork/run_-5obKGrJFD0H\">Code repository</a>\n  </div>\n  <h2>Data provenance</h2>\n  <p class=\"prose small\">Every chart, count and table on this page is built in the browser from the JSON blocks embedded in this file.     if w in txt.lower(): print('BANNED',w)
hed=sum(len(re.findall(r'\b%s\b'%h, txt.lower())) for h in ['may','might','likely','suggests','suggest','appears','appear','could','perhaps','possibly'])
print('hedges',hed, 'per1000', round(hed/words*1000,1))
sents=[s for s in re.split(r'(?<=[.!?])\s+', re.sub(r'\s+',' ',txt)) if len(s.split())>2]
L=sorted(len(s.split()) for s in sents); q=statistics.quantiles(L,n=4); print('sent IQR', q[2]-q[0], q)
print('hrefs', sorted(set(hrefs)))
print('srcs', srcs)
tex=open(P+'paper.tex').read()
nums=set(re.findall(r'(?<![\w.])\d[\d,]*\.?\d*%?', txt))
missing=[n for n in nums if n.rstrip('%').replace(',','{,}') not in tex and n.rstrip('%') not in tex]
print('numbers on page not in paper.tex:', sorted(missing, key=lambda x: float(x.rstrip('%').replace(',','') or 0)))
EOF

I tested it in headless Chromium at 390, 1280 and 1440 px, using real clicks and keyboard input on every control. There were no console errors, no network requests, no sideways scrolling and no overlapping chart labels. A clicked term keeps its definition open until you press Escape or click elsewhere.

**What's on the page:**
- **The finding:** the headline "+23%" (MeSH IRR 1.23 [1.12, 1.36]) next to a forest chart of the three folds and the pooled estimate. You can switch between the co-primary and the strict primary specification, choose which folds show, and show or hide co-transfer as the competing channel.
- **How it works:** a five-stage stepper that follows one real entry, "EPR steering" into Artificial Intelligence in 2011: host share 0.142, co-transfer 0, 37 newcomer papers. The out-of-fold prediction was 18.3 without the host share and 21.6 with it.
- **Explore the evidence:**
  - A browser over all 5,086 recorded host-entry events, with filter, search, sort and paging. Picking an event shows its input, the baseline prediction, the method prediction and the observed outcome side by side.

- **Try it:** a slider that splits the recorded entries at a host-share cut and recomputes uptake rates above and below it. The page labels this as a raw contrast with no fixed effects or controls.
- **Where it fails:**

  - The results by origin field.

  - The paper's limitations.
